propositions: Verifier step budget exhausts on legitimate epic/multi-criterion validation due to undersized defaults (8 steps/criterion, 48-step floor) and absence of evidence-surface scaling, causing false-unmet failures that drive attestation-laundering.

Budget formula must account for child ticket traversal cost (epic criteria require 5-10 requests per direct child) and fixed overhead; new config keys completion_verify_child_traversal_steps and completion_verify_fixed_overhead_steps parametrize the term inside verify_step_floor for both primary sizing and plan_recovery_pool consumers.

Re-verification of identical criteria re-proves all evidence within a run; cross-run PASS-verdict cache seeded from file-impact-scoped blob fingerprints eliminates redundant work while detecting invalidation on content changes or ref-targeted verification.

Seeded verdicts from prior runs must bypass finalizer downgrade and omit from primary context to prevent re-verification; merge_finalizer_with_bank preserves same-run downgrades while seeded:true records remain credited verbatim.

Runaway protection (tool_calls_limit, loop detection) is independent of budget floor; larger per-criterion defaults and clamp (24/160/960 replacing 8/48/480) ensure legitimate validation proceeds without artificial exhaustion while runaway guards remain authoritative.
